author: Ivan Ball-llovera
name: MMCA query slice (query + handler)
description: One read-side vertical slice for an existing MMCA module: a cacheable query record plus its handler loading the aggregate through IUnitOfWork and mapping it to a DTO. Generated into a folder named after the use case.

app.description: The solution / root namespace this slice belongs to, for example Contoso.Support.

module.description: The module this slice goes into, plural PascalCase, for example Billing.

aggregate.description: The aggregate root the handler loads, singular PascalCase, for example Invoice.

aggregateLower.description: Lower-case aggregate name: local variables and the prose in the doc comments.

useCaseNamespace.description: The use-case namespace segment, derived from the slice name so the folder, the namespace, and the type names agree.

manualInstructions.text:
1. Map the query in your module's controller (reads usually come from EntityControllerBase; add an action for this one).
2. Keep its CacheKey inside your module's *CacheKeys.Prefix. The caching decorator matches reads to invalidating commands by STRING PREFIX, so a key that drifts out of the prefix goes stale silently and nothing fails.
3. Handlers are convention-scanned by Scrutor, so there is no DI registration to add.
